verdict.rationale: The evidence describes a different mechanism, not committable suggestion diffs applied with one click inside the PR. Each review comment has a 'Fix with your Agent' button that sends the issue and suggested code to an external coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and others), which then makes the change. Nothing shows a native, directly committable suggestion block in the PR, so this is an adjacent handoff feature rather than the story's capability.

support.subject: As a developer, review comments include committable suggested diffs I can apply with one click
